prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1129; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss. Insured reports vehicle was turning left at an intersection when it was struck by an oncoming vehicle. Both drivers reported to be present at scene. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant states they are experiencing knee pain following the collision and has been seen by a medical provider. Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Explained the claims process and requested medical records and treatment notes.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles from the insured. Damage to the front driver side of the insured vehicle and the rear passenger side of the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported left turn collision. Scheduled a vehicle inspection with the appraiser.

Entry 4: Obtained the police report. Responding officer noted the other driver was proceeding straight through the intersection on a green signal. Citation issued to the insured for failure to yield. Liability position under review.

Entry 5: Claimant provided medical documentation indicating a knee injury with ongoing physical therapy recommended. Discussed with supervisor. Set reserves for bodily injury pending receipt of complete treatment records. Will follow up with claimant in one week for an update on recovery and treatment status.
